firstPlayerRule: Each player draws a building tile and places it on its matching board space. The player whose tile is closest to 1A goes first; play passes to the left.
clarifications: Compare the letter before the number: the rulebook gives 9A as closer to 1A than 1B. Leave the drawn tiles on the board.
